sections.title: Who we are and when this Policy applies

blocks.x: Noxtill LLC is an Arizona limited liability company with public business address 4539 N 22ND ST STE R, Phoenix, AZ 85016, United States.

This Privacy Policy describes personal data Noxtill handles as a controller for its website, account administration, sales, support, security, product analytics, billing-related administration, marketing, recruitment and similar business purposes.

For Customer Content processed inside a customer workspace on the customer’s documented instructions—such as end-customer records, staff/payroll data, messages, bookings, documents and transaction records—Noxtill generally acts as a processor/service provider and the customer is the controller/business. Those processor activities are governed by the DPA.

This Policy may apply to website visitors, prospects, customer owners/admins, authorized users, support contacts, event attendees, suppliers, partners and job applicants. Individuals whose data exists only inside a customer’s workspace should ordinarily direct requests first to that customer because Noxtill processes that data on the customer’s instructions.

Depending on the relationship, we may process identity/contact data; business and employment information; account credentials and MFA/security metadata; subscription/transaction references; support communications; device/browser/IP and log data; product usage/feature telemetry; cookie/preferences; sales and marketing engagement; fraud/security indicators; integration metadata; feedback and information voluntarily submitted.

Noxtill should minimize collection and avoid requesting government identifiers, special-category data, precise location or financial-account credentials unless a specific feature or law requires them. Full payment-card details should be handled by the Merchant of Record/payment provider rather than directly stored by Noxtill unless a separately compliant architecture is implemented.

Customer Content may include customer profiles, purchases, orders, products, bookings, loyalty, credit balances, messages, reviews, service requests, staff profiles, attendance, payroll inputs, field-service locations, delivery data, call recordings/transcripts, contracts, signatures, uploaded files, website forms, accounting records, supplier records, inventory, workflows, AI prompts/outputs and related operational data.
The customer determines why this data is processed and is responsible for lawful collection, notice and instructions.

Noxtill may obtain controller data directly from an individual, a customer organization, automated use of the Services, authorized connected providers, Stripe and other payment transaction parties to administer subscriptions, and support or sales interactions.
Where privacy law requires notice for indirectly obtained data, Noxtill should provide it within the required period unless an exemption applies.
Where GDPR/UK GDPR or similar laws require a legal basis, purposes may rely on:

items: performance of a contract for account/service delivery;
legitimate interests for security, fraud prevention, reliability and ordinary B2B administration where not overridden;
legal obligation for tax, sanctions, law-enforcement or regulatory duties;

Target WCAG 2.2 AA for public pages and core UI, including keyboard access, non-color-only states, accessible forms, focus visible, alt text, responsive reflow, reduced motion, screen reader support, print styles and alternatives. Publish observed testing results and remediation contact rather than claim certification.

Noxtill aims to design its public website and core product interfaces with WCAG 2.2 AA as the product target. The U.S. Department of Justice identifies WCAG as helpful technical guidance for web accessibility. Noxtill should not claim conformance until the relevant release has been audited.

faqs.q: How long is the free trial?
faqs.a: Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial. You do not need a payment card to start an ordinary trial.

faqs.q: What is limited during the trial?
faqs.a: Trials include a set allowance, such as 200 AI credits. Paid calling, paid SMS and marketing campaigns unlock only after you add a payment method.

faqs.q: What happens when my trial ends?
faqs.a: You get a 72-hour grace period to activate a paid plan. During grace you can sign in and activate, but paid or metered activity stays off.

faqs.q: What happens if I do not activate?
faqs.a: After the 72-hour grace period the workspace is suspended. Billable automations stop, but owners keep access to billing and export.

faqs.q: How long can I export my data after suspension?
faqs.a: You have 30 days after suspension to recover or export supported workspace data. After that, data becomes eligible for deletion under our retention rules.

faqs.q: Can I upgrade or change plans?
faqs.a: Yes. Upgrades apply immediately and are prorated. Downgrades take effect at your next renewal.

faqs.q: How do I cancel?
faqs.a: Account owners can cancel from billing settings at any time. Cancellation stops future renewals; access continues until the end of the paid period.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund?
faqs.a: Your first paid activation may qualify for a voluntary refund if you ask within 7 calendar days and have not materially used the paid product.

faqs.q: Do my legal rights still apply?
faqs.a: Yes. The voluntary policy never limits rights you have by law, for example for unauthorized charges, billing errors or defective services.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: Payments are processed by Stripe. Cards are supported, and Apple Pay or Google Pay may be available depending on your country, browser and device.

faqs.q: What happens if a payment fails?
faqs.a: A failed renewal is handled separately from trial expiry. We notify the account owner and retry before restricting paid features.

faqs.q: What is an AI credit?
faqs.a: One standard AI action, such as a reply draft or summary. Larger tasks use more credits, and you see how many before you run them.

faqs.q: How do I request access to or deletion of my data?
faqs.a: Use the Privacy Choices Center to submit a verified request. If a Noxtill business holds your data, we route the request to that business.

faqs.q: How do I change cookie settings?
faqs.a: Open Privacy Choices and switch analytics, marketing or functional cookies on or off. Strictly necessary cookies cannot be switched off.

faqs.q: Is AI-generated content always correct?
faqs.a: No. AI output can be wrong or incomplete. Important actions wait for a person to approve them, on every plan.

faqs.q: Are calls recorded?
faqs.a: Only where the business has enabled recording, given the required notice and collected consent where the law requires it.

faqs.q: Can businesses send me WhatsApp or SMS messages?
faqs.a: Only with the consent the law requires for that channel and message type. Every marketing message must offer a way to opt out.

faqs.q: Can I connect my own tools through the API?
faqs.a: Yes. API and integration use is covered by the API & Integration Terms, including rate limits and security responsibilities.

faqs.q: How do I report a security vulnerability?
faqs.a: Follow the Vulnerability Disclosure Policy and email support@noxtill.com with details. Please do not access other customers’ data.

faqs.q: Who are Noxtill’s subprocessors?
faqs.a: The verified register is published on the Subprocessor page. Account owners can subscribe to change notices.

faqs.q: Can I use Noxtill outside the United States?
faqs.a: Yes. The global baseline applies everywhere, with regional notices where we have reviewed local law. Check local requirements for your own use.
